dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: (This diary is soaked, but parts of its contents are still readable.)

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...Gonrokurou also vowed not to return to the army. He will bring his wife and kids here once things get better..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...It's real funny. Not long ago, we were still enemies fighting each other sword-to-sword — fighting for our precious lords and false ideals..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...To no longer be bound by complex morality or by hierarchy and obligation. To breathe the free air for the first time, and to receive freedom's fruit in turn..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...Brothers, let's unite. Even in the face of the Raiden Shogun's wave-sundering blade..."
